verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at docs.runanywhere.ai/llms.txt (HTTP 200) indexing the documentation, and a second llms.txt exists on www.runanywhere.ai. Doc pages are served as raw .md URLs, and a dedicated 'vibe-coding' section gives agent-oriented integration paths such as the Expo/React Native guide. Missing for 10: no hands-on or independent report of an agent actually consuming these docs successfully, and no evidence of an expanded llms-full.txt-style bundle.
